risk_register.title: Table 2 FS occupational-field proportions do not follow strict 2-decimal rounding
risk_register.quantity: Administration & Media rows of the FS panel
risk_register.impact: Cosmetic. The raw field Ns (512/560/1944/824) and the four proportions are all present and correct to ~1dp (0.5 / 0.2 ~ 0.51 / 0.21). The 2-dp choice appears to force the column to sum to 1.00. It does not affect any analytic result, model, or conclusion.
risk_register.fix: Report Administration as 0.51 and Media as 0.21 (strict rounding), or add a note that proportions are rounded-then-summed to 1.00.
